newsitem.title: ESTONIA: U.S. Duke interested in Estonia-report.
newsitem.headline: U.S. Duke interested in Estonia-report.

text.p: One of the top U.S. energy companies, Duke Power, is interested in the privatisation of the energy sector in Estonia, newspaper Aripaev said on Monday.
The newspaper said representatives of Duke Power subsidiary Duke Energy had visited Estonia to find out more about the privatisation of the state-owned Estonian Energy.
It quoted Duke Energy business planning manager Harold Burnham as saying that no agreements were signed but that he was interested in what patterns the privatisation would follow.
Estonia has already signed a letter of intent with Northern States Power subsidiary NRG to invest in its power system.
The government has set a deadline of January 1 for the energy firms to draw up plans for their privatisation.
The newspaper quoted deputy economy minister chancellor Arvi Hamburg as saying that Duke Power had made a "reconaissance" of the Estonian energy system.
